verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that serverless inference is billed per token on a self-serve, pay-as-you-go basis with no sales step ("send tokens, and pay only for what you use"). The batch docs also refer to "Serverless per-token prices" (batch runs at 50% off), which implies a per-token rate card exists. However, no evidence shows an actual public price list or actual per-model rates, and nothing shows that pricing covers every hosted model. Missing for 10: a public pricing page with per-token rates, confirmation that every hosted model is listed, and independent corroboration that prices are visible without contacting sales.
